text:
sofia: Quick design review — toggles between org/project spend views + invoice placement. Uploaded screens to the Figma file. Thoughts on compact rows vs an explicit invoice row?

kai: I lean explicit invoice row. Compactness hides affordances; users keep asking where to download.

rachael: Agree with kai. If we inline the invoice link in compact mode it reads noisy. Could we make the download CTA appear on hover/focus instead? :thinking:

dennis: Hover-only isn't accessible. Need keyboard focus state and a persistent affordance for screen readers (aria labels).

alex: What about a small chevron that expands invoice details when clicked? Keeps density but surfaces actions.

sofia: Good call. Expansion could surface token breakdown + download. But — scope question — should expansion be scoped? In org view, expanding every row could get huge.

rachael: Expansion should respect active scope. In org view expand shows invoice groups (per project) with a "Download consolidated" CTA at the top.

kai: Also the token breakdown tooltip we prototyped uses a color-only legend. Needs labels and better contrast for low vision and greyscale prints.

dennis: +1. Keyboard users need to tab into the tooltip content. Suggest convert tooltip -> inline popover with close button and tabindex support; aria-modal=false so it doesn't trap.

sofia: Microcopy suggestion: change "Tokens" to "Compute tokens (est.)" — helps clarify billing context.

alex: Could we show an estimated $ next to token denom in muted text? Helpful but adds noise.

rachael: Prefer $ in expanded details only, not in the compact ledger. Keeps surface light.

design-bot: Accessibility check — contrast issues: sparkline color #6C8EF5 on #FFFFFF is okay, but axis ticks currently #B3B9C9 fail WCAG AA at 12px.

sofia: Good catch. We'll move ticks to #8A95A8 and bump font-size to 13px where possible.

kai: UX nit: scope toggle is in the left toolbar today; users expect it near the date selector. Feels like a global filter.

rachael: Move sounds right. If we move it, we should persist selection in the URL so links are shareable.

dennis: Also confirm keyboard focus order: scope toggle -> date -> search -> filter chips. I'll draft a focus map.

alex: One more: invoice download CTA — primary or secondary? For org view, consolidated download should be primary; per-project row CTAs can be secondary.

sofia: Proposed action items:
- surface invoice CTA in compact via expandable row; keep consolidated primary CTA in org view
- convert token tooltip to inline popover with keyboard focus and close button
- update microcopy to 'Compute tokens (est.)' and show $ only in expanded details
- fix axis tick contrast + increase font-size
- move scope toggle next to date and persist in URL

rachael: I'll update the Figma and add ARIA annotations. Assigning follow-ups: @dennis for keyboard flow, @kai for color QA, @alex for interaction dev.

dennis: On it. I'll mock keyboard tab order and send a tiny interactive prototype (no heavy dev).

kai: I'll run color contrast tests and add alternate palettes for dark mode.

alex: I'll prototype the expand chevron and ensure screen reader support. Example aria snippet: <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="invoice-1234">Details</button> and update to aria-expanded="true" when open.

sofia: Thanks team :raised_hands: I'll update the PRD and link the new frames. Expect a follow-up sync on Wednesday.

design-bot: Note: created task #4567 for 'Invoice row expand + popover accessibility' and added checklist: [ARIA labels, keyboard order, color contrast, microcopy].
